source: | 已取消稳定检查，请刷新确认。
en: | Stability check cancelled. Refresh to confirm the current state.

source: | 无法核实关闭后的进程状态：{0}
en: | Could not verify process state after closing: {0}

source: | 观察到新进程，未自动追加或结束，请刷新确认。
en: | New processes were observed and left untouched. Refresh to review them.

source: 目标不属于已确认的 Steam 客户端进程，未强制结束。
en: This is not a confirmed Steam client process. It was not force-closed.

source: | 观察到新进程 PID {0}，未自动结束，请刷新确认。
en: | New process IDs observed: {0}. They were left untouched; refresh to review them.

source: | 稳定检查未完成：{0}
en: | Stability check incomplete: {0}

source: 跳过：进程所属会话已变化
en: Skipped: the process session changed

source: Steam 目标身份不完整或受系统保护。
en: The Steam process identity is incomplete or system-protected.

source: Steam 目标已退出或身份发生变化。
en: The Steam process has exited or its identity changed.

source: Steam 目标的关键进程检查未通过。
en: The Steam process failed the critical-process check.

source: Steam 主程序的数字签名未通过 Windows 信任验证，未启动此文件。
en: Windows could not verify the Steam executable's digital signature. This file was not launched.

source: 此文件的签名发布者不是 Valve，未发送 Steam 退出请求。
en: The executable is not signed by Valve. No Steam shutdown request was sent.

source: Steam 主程序路径无法核实，未发送退出请求。
en: The Steam executable path could not be verified. No shutdown request was sent.

source: Windows 未能发送 Steam 正常退出请求。
en: Windows could not send the normal Steam shutdown request.

source: Steam 服务或其他账户会话不在正常退出范围，未执行操作。
en: Steam services and other users or sessions are outside this shutdown action. No action was taken.

source: 未找到唯一且可核实的 Steam 主进程，未执行操作。
en: A unique, verifiable Steam client was not found. No action was taken.

source: 仅选择了部分 Steam 进程或清单已变化。正常退出需要确认完整客户端组，未执行操作。
en: Only part of Steam is selected, or the process list changed. Confirm the complete client group for normal shutdown. No action was taken.

source: Steam 组内有受保护进程，未发送退出请求。
en: A process in the Steam group is protected. No shutdown request was sent.

source: Steam 进程组在确认后发生变化，未发送退出请求。
en: The Steam process group changed after confirmation. No shutdown request was sent.

source: 已请求 Steam 正常退出，正在等待客户端和辅助进程结束；不会自动强制结束。
en: Steam was asked to exit normally. Waiting for the client and its helpers; they will not be force-closed automatically.

source: 保护规则已变化，已停止等待和后续操作；此前的正常退出请求无法撤销。
en: Protection changed. Waiting and further actions stopped; the earlier shutdown request cannot be undone.

source: 原 Steam 进程已退出，但观察到新进程；未自动关闭新进程，请刷新确认。
en: The original Steam processes exited, but new processes appeared. They were left untouched; refresh to review them.

source: Steam 客户端已退出并通过短时稳定检查；此结果不代表游戏存档或云同步已完成。
en: Steam exited and passed a brief stability check. This does not confirm saved games or completed cloud sync.

source: Steam 仍在运行或退出尚未稳定，可能在处理游戏、下载或同步。未强制结束；需要再次确认才能结束原清单。
en: Steam is still running or has not remained closed. A game, download or sync may be pending. Nothing was force-closed; ending the original list requires another confirmation.

source: 已取消等待 Steam；已发送的正常退出请求无法撤销，未强制结束。
en: Stopped waiting for Steam. The earlier shutdown request cannot be undone; nothing was force-closed.

source: 已取消，未发送 Steam 退出请求。
en: Cancelled. No Steam shutdown request was sent.

source: Steam 退出未完成：{0}
en: Steam shutdown incomplete: {0}
